stem:
The diagram shows two spherical mirrors. Shading marks the non-reflecting back of each mirror. Light comes from the object side shown.

Which statement correctly names the mirrors from the way their reflecting surfaces curve?

options.text: Mirror X is concave and Mirror Y is convex.
Mirror X is a plane mirror and Mirror Y is concave.
Both mirrors are convex because both outlines look curved.
Mirror X is convex because its back looks hollow on the shaded side.

teacher.key_rationale: Name mirrors from the reflecting surface: X curves inward (concave); Y curves outward (convex).
